claims.subject: fixed-public-datasets
claims.statement: InvisiMole was cross-checked against all fixed public datasets; result=matched.
claims.verification_rationale: Matched datasets: etda-threat-group-cards, microsoft-threat-actor-mapping, misp-microsoft-activity-group, misp-threat-actor. Exact normalized-name matching and aggregation aliases do not prove one-to-one vendor cluster identity. A no-match result records completed searches, not actor nonexistence.

claims.subject: espionage
claims.statement: InvisiMole has motivation espionage: ESET explicitly describes InvisiMole as a cyber-espionage group and documents extensive spying capabilities.
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=research; motivation is not inferred from sponsorship.

claims.subject: relationship--invisimole--gamaredon-delivery
claims.statement: InvisiMole cooperates-with actor--gamaredon: ESET observed Gamaredon malware establishing initial access and delivering InvisiMole to a small, selected subset of targets. ESET explicitly treats the two as distinct groups with different TTPs.
claims.verification_rationale: Delivery cooperation does not establish exact identity or a part-of relationship.

claims.subject: malware--invisimole

claims.subject: activity--invisimole-eastern-europe-2019-2020
claims.statement: InvisiMole conducted or is associated with InvisiMoleによる東欧の軍事・外交組織へのスパイ活動: ESETは2019年後半から2020年6月18日の報告時点まで、東欧の少数の高位組織、特に軍事部門と政府・行政に属する外交使節団を標的とする攻撃を観測した。Gamaredonが先に侵入した端末の一部へ、より選別的にInvisiMoleを配布した。
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=research; observation dates remain separate from report dates.
